mapper.select: SELECT policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,store_id AS storeId,sku_id AS skuId,enabled, expiry_basis AS expiryBasis,shelf_life_days AS shelfLifeDays,near_expiry_days AS nearExpiryDays, industry,template_version_id AS templateVersionId,effective_from AS effectiveFrom, content_sha256 AS contentSha256,state FROM cat_lot_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND policy_version_id=#{policyVersionId}

SELECT policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,store_id AS storeId,sku_id AS skuId,enabled, expiry_basis AS expiryBasis,shelf_life_days AS shelfLifeDays,near_expiry_days AS nearExpiryDays, industry,template_version_id AS templateVersionId,effective_from AS effectiveFrom, content_sha256 AS contentSha256,state FROM cat_lot_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND state='PUBLISHED' AND effective_from<=#{effectiveAt} ORDER BY effective_from DESC,policy_version_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT policyVersionId,storeId,skuId,enabled,expiryBasis,shelfLifeDays,nearExpiryDays,industry, templateVersionId,effectiveFrom,contentSha256,state FROM ( SELECT policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,store_id AS storeId,sku_id AS skuId,enabled, expiry_basis AS expiryBasis,shelf_life_days AS shelfLifeDays,near_expiry_days AS nearExpiryDays, industry,template_version_id AS templateVersionId,effective_from AS effectiveFrom, content_sha256 AS contentSha256,state, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY sku_id ORDER BY effective_from DESC,policy_version_id DESC) AS rn FROM cat_lot_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND state='PUBLISHED' AND effective_from<=#{effectiveAt} ) ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY skuId
